system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature

Your dreams give weight and form to the thoughts and ideals you wish to make real. When you complete a rest, you can select one weapon group and gain proficiency in those weapons. When you wield a weapon from that group, it takes on an ethereal, almost ghost like form.

Only you can wield this weapon and its damage type becomes Psychic. While wielding the weapon, you can choose to spend Oni-Coils to utilize one of the following abilities. If the affected creature is already making a save throw as a result of damage or to reduce damage, then on a failed save apply these abilities effects:

Memory Haze. As part of dealing [Weapon Damage] you can spend 1 Oni-Coil to force the affected creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the affected creature becomes Confused as their more pressing thoughts become fleeting memories.

Stolen Thoughts. As part of dealing [Weapon Damage], you can spend 2 Oni-Coils to force the affected creature to make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, you become aware of their most immediate goals, and they forget them for the next minute.
